title: Singapore Residents' Total Spending on E-Commerce Platforms and Measures to Support Local Businesses
what_it_is: Singapore Residents' Total Spending on E-Commerce Platforms and Measures to Support Local Businesses

sections.label: Overseas e-commerce spending tracking
sections.summary: MTI does not track Singapore residents' expenditure on overseas e-commerce platforms.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: The Ministry of Trade and Industry (MTI) does not track the expenditure made by Singapore residents on overseas e-commerce platforms.

sections.label: Enterprise Singapore e-commerce support
sections.summary: ESG helps companies build data analytics and order fulfilment capabilities, join e-commerce platforms, and develop omni-channel strategies, citing Castlery and Skin Inc.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: Enterprise Singapore (ESG) supports companies in building their capabilities in data analytics and order fulfilment, getting on board e-commerce platforms, such as Amazon and Qoo10, and developing omni-channel sales strategies.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: For example, ESG provided targeted branding and strategy support to homegrown company Castlery in their expansion into the United States market in 2019.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: Today, Castlery's international orders account for more than 70% of its revenue, compared to 20% before the COVID-19 pandemic.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: For example, ESG supported homegrown company Skin Inc in developing a mobile app that provides customers with personalised diagnoses of their skin condition and recommendations of customised products.
